data.name: Nawroz
data.gender_notes: Nawroz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word for 'new day', Nawroz symbolizes the beginning of a new cycle. It is a name of hope and renewal, associated with the first day of Nowruz, the Persian New Year. The name Nawroz carries the meaning “New Day” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawroz usually hope their child will grow to embody new day and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embracing new beginnings and the cycle of life.
data.etymology: Nawroz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “New Day.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawroz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Nawroz holds significant cultural importance among various communities, predominantly Persians, in different parts of the world. It is celebrated as a symbol of unity, harmony, and the beginning of a fresh start. The tradition of Nowruz includes several customs, such as cleaning houses, preparing new clothes, cooking special meals, and exchanging gifts to mark the occasion.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Nawroz represents the opportunity to reflect on past mistakes, intentions, and aspirations and to begin anew. It encourages introspection, self-improvement, and striving towards personal growth. The idea is to leave behind the negative and welcome positivity, reminding us that every day is a chance to begin anew and make a difference.
